scenes.title: Same site, same task, same agent
scenes.narration: Same website. Same task. Same A I agent. Through the raw U I: zero for three. Through Web M C P tools: three for three. AgentReady is the benchmark that measures this gap, for any site.

scenes.title: The instrument
scenes.narration: This is AgentReady, live in production. Each site gets audited twice: once through the raw interface, once through Web M C P tools, and scored zero to one hundred. Our demo store scores one hundred with tools. The autopsy shows why: all three U I runs timed out at fifteen steps. Three runs. Early data, real methodology.

scenes.title: Two authors, one document
scenes.narration: The dashboard itself is agent native. My agent calls draft readiness report, and the report appears in the editor on the page. Now the key moment: I edit a line by hand. Before revising, the agent calls get report draft, and reads my edit back. The page is a two way channel. Then queue live audit fires a real audit: Cloudflare Queues, a headless browser, a Workers A I agent, results in D one. And my agent reads them back, live.

scenes.title: Closing the loop
scenes.narration: The same protocol runs our demo store. My agent searches products, adds to cart, and starts checkout, through tools. I click a second item in by hand, and we share one cart, updated from both sides. And here is the loop: this store is the test subject. It is the exact site the benchmark scored zero for three through the U I.

scenes.title: Are you agent-ready?
scenes.narration: Thirteen tools across two surfaces. Real serverless audits, live in production. M I T licensed. Every site that adopts Web M C P will ask: did it work? This is the benchmark that answers. AgentReady: the readiness benchmark for the agent native web. Audit your site. It is live today.
